cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: More Official Than You
cards.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your bow at the ceremony was adequate. Mine follows the founder's original diagram.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The founder asked us to wave instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wave on my left; I'll bow from the constitution. That's where his diagram is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep that programme visible. I'll bow; you demonstrate the signed exception.

reason: Arrange a joint performance around B preferred wave while A continues to classify its authority as subordinate to the constitution.
